services.name: Audiobooks of the account: list and listening place

caroline.description: The audiobooks of SquirrelWisdom (the public catalog and the owner's own, MP3): find a book, know and set where the owner stopped (the file and the second, the same on every device and on the web), bookmarks, the playback speed, and play, pause and seek on the screen

tools.name: play_audiobook
tools.description: Opens an audiobook and plays it from the place where the owner stopped

tools.name: resume
tools.description: Goes on playing the open audiobook

tools.name: seek
tools.description: Moves within the file by this many seconds (negative: back)

tools.name: bookmark_here
tools.description: Adds a bookmark at the place the owner is listening to now (or tells that it has one)

tools.name: next_file
tools.description: Goes to the next file of the audiobook

tools.name: now_playing
tools.description: Which audiobook is open, the file, the time and whether it plays
